unlisted_practices: Evaluating LLMs in a simulated hospital environment across end-to-end clinical pathways with agent-based patient and physician simulators
Three-tiered evaluation of clinical efficacy, process competency, and professional ethics

screen.reason: The paper introduces CP-Env, a simulated agentic hospital environment to benchmark LLM clinical decision-making across clinical pathways, evaluating clinical efficacy, process competency, and professional ethics without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard.
